body: Flag: POOR (leverage-driven wipe-out; no regulator fraud finding located). Hyderabad power-EPC group whose Lanco Infratech was among RBI's first 12 IBC referrals (2017) with group debt reported ~Rs 40,000 cr+; after creditors rejected Thriveni Earthmovers' revised bid, NCLT Hyderabad ordered liquidation (27-Aug-2018) -- equity effectively zero; IBBI records show liquidation still in process with a May-2026 stakeholder list. Lenders also pursued promoter Madhusudhan Rao as personal guarantor (NCLT personal-guarantee insolvency matter, 2021). Governance pattern: listed holdco funded multiple SPVs (Amarkantak, Udupi -- sold to Adani 2015, Teesta, Babandh, Vidarbha) and an Australian coal acquisition (Griffin, 2011) with corporate guarantees; EPC revenue booked from own group SPVs (related-party revenue inflating the holdco P&L); multiple CDR rounds (2013-2014) before IBC. A Business Standard analysis used Lanco to illustrate how a failed group-level resolution destroys value when each SPV is resolved separately. No CBI/SEBI fraud finding against the promoter was found in this scan -- do not describe it as fraud. Lesson: EPC 'order book' from captive SPVs is not third-party revenue; group guarantees convert one project's failure into holdco failure.

data.red_flags: related-party EPC revenue; group guarantees; CDR then IBC

title: Lanco group (Lagadapati Madhusudhan Rao family) — governance history
